glows.soft_glow: A soft diffuse glow of pure warm light on a pure solid black background, a macro photograph of veiling glare inside a camera lens. The glow sits slightly off centre, with a small intense core that fades through a smooth wide halo into deep black. The falloff is not symmetrical: one side of the halo spreads further and looks faintly patchy, and a few tiny dust specks catch the light inside it. Fine film grain, low dynamic range, the light source itself is outside the frame.
glows.hot_core: An overexposed white-hot core of pure light blooming on a pure black background, a photograph of a point source blown out inside a camera lens. The core is clipped to flat white, surrounded by a lopsided bloom halo that leans toward the lower left, with a very faint warm veiling glare drifting across one half of the frame. The edge of the bloom shows a thin amber to orange chromatic rim. Slight sensor noise in the dark areas, real optical imperfection, the only thing in frame is the light.
glows.cool_glow: A soft cold blue-white glow of pure light on a pure black background, a macro photograph of glare through a slightly hazy lens. The glow is placed a little off axis, with a gentle irregular edge and faint uneven internal texture like breath on glass. Its outer halo shifts colour subtly, cyan on one side and near-neutral white on the other, an artefact of the lens coating. Delicate film grain, very smooth falloff, the frame is otherwise empty black.
glows.veiling_fog: An extremely soft wide veil of dim hazy light spreading unevenly across a pure black background, a photograph of veiling glare from an old uncoated lens with the light source just outside the frame. The fog of light has no defined edge, brighter in the upper right corner and thinning to black on the opposite side, with organic patchiness and a barely visible faint second lobe lower down. Low contrast, low dynamic range, subtle grain, only light on black.
glows.smoky_haze: Faint wisps of soft glowing haze on a pure black background, a long-exposure photograph of light scattering through fine fog inside a camera lens. The wisps have a subtle streaky structure, very dim and diffuse, drifting off to one side of the frame rather than sitting in the centre. One wisp is noticeably denser and slightly warmer in tone than the rest, with a few tiny bright dust motes suspended in it. Grainy, soft, the frame otherwise empty black.
glows.airy_core: A tiny intensely bright point of pure light surrounded by a small soft diffraction disc, on a pure solid black background, an extreme macro photograph of a point source focused through a camera lens. The core is a clean white dot fading into a compact halo, with one faint concentric diffraction ring just visible around it. The halo is slightly stronger on the left side and shows a whisper of blue fringing at its outer edge. Placed just off centre, fine grain, otherwise empty black.
glows.halation_bloom: A bright ball of warm light with a wide reddish halation halo on a pure black background, a photograph of a point source blooming on film where light scatters back through the emulsion. The centre is blown out to white, the halation ring glows orange to deep red as it spreads outward, and the halo is uneven, bulging toward the top of the frame. Scattered faint dust specks sit in the glow. Soft, grainy, photographic, only light on black.
glows.chromatic_halo: A soft round glow of pure light with a distinct chromatic halo edge on a pure black background, a macro photograph of a bright source through a lens with strong colour aberration. The inner glow is white to pale yellow, then the rim separates into a thin band of magenta on one side and green-cyan on the opposite side, the colour split slightly off axis. The halo is a little broken on its lower edge, thinner and dimmer there. Subtle grain, frame otherwise empty black.
glows.sensor_bloom: A hard overexposed blob of pure white light with digital sensor bloom on a pure black background, a photograph of a clipped highlight from a digital camera. The core is flat clipped white with a faint vertical smear of light leaking above and below it, and a soft halo that fades unevenly, wider on the right side. Faint magenta tinge at the edge where the colour channels clip differently, subtle sensor noise in the black, the only thing in frame is the highlight.
glows.hairy_bloom: A blown white core surrounded by hundreds of fine radial spokes reaching far out across a pure black background, a macro photograph of a point source flaring through an uncoated 65mm lens. The spokes vary in length and brightness with a few reaching much further than the rest, and the burst runs denser on one side than the other. A soft cool haze fills the space between them. Bright, hairy, slightly off centre, fine grain, only light on black.

ghosts.polygon_ghost: A single translucent hexagonal aperture ghost on a pure black background, a macro photograph of an internal reflection inside a camera lens. The six-sided disc of dim pale light has slightly rounded corners, a rim faintly brighter than its interior, and a soft pale green tint from the lens coating. One corner of the hexagon is a touch brighter and the opposite edge is slightly blurred, as if the reflection is not perfectly in focus. The ghost sits a little off centre, subtle grain, empty black around it.
ghosts.pentagon_bokeh: A single soft five-sided aperture ghost of pale light on a pure black background, a macro photograph of an internal lens reflection shaped by a five-blade iris. The pentagon edges are slightly wobbly and organic rather than geometrically perfect, one corner is marginally brighter, and a faint dust texture is visible inside. A thin magenta fringe runs along its right-hand edge. Dim, translucent, slightly off axis, fine grain, the rest of the frame is empty black.
ghosts.hollow_ghost: A single large hollow aperture ghost on a pure black background, a macro photograph of an internal lens reflection: a thin soft-edged polygonal ring of dim light with a darker translucent interior. The rim brightness is uneven, brighter along the lower edge and almost fading out at the top, and the ring has a faint cyan tint from the anti-reflective coating with a slight warm shift on one side. Off centre, subtle grain, only the ghost on black.
ghosts.dirty_disc: A single large defocused disc of pale blue light on a pure black background, a macro photograph of an out-of-focus internal reflection through a dirty lens element. The soft-edged circle contains visible dust specks, tiny dark bubbles and a faint greasy smudge cutting across one quarter of it. Brightness is uneven across the disc, and the rim on the left is a touch sharper and brighter than the right. Off axis, fine grain, empty black outside.
ghosts.soft_disc: A single defocused circular ghost of dim light on a pure black background, a macro photograph of an internal lens reflection. The disc has a softly glowing rim slightly brighter than its interior, a gently wobbling imperfect edge and faint internal mottling. The rim colour drifts from pale green on one side to faint magenta on the other, a coating artefact. A very faint smaller second copy of the disc sits partly overlapping it. Slightly off centre, subtle grain, empty black around.
ghosts.smeared_disc: A single defocused disc of light smeared to one side on a pure black background, a macro photograph of an off-axis internal lens reflection stretched radially. The soft oval shape has a brighter crescent along one edge and a faint red-then-blue chromatic fringe where it is stretched most. The interior is slightly uneven, and a faint dust speck sits inside it. Positioned off centre with the elongation pointing toward the edge of the frame, fine grain, empty black background.
ghosts.orb_cluster: A loose cluster of overlapping defocused ghost orbs of very dim light on a pure black background, a macro photograph of stacked internal reflections from a multi-element lens. The orbs are various sizes with soft imperfect edges, a few with faint dust texture inside, and each carries a slightly different coating tint of green, magenta or cyan. They overlap unevenly, the largest is the dimmest, and one small orb is noticeably brighter than the rest. Off centre, subtle grain, empty black elsewhere.
ghosts.drifting_orbs: Several faint translucent ghost orbs strung diagonally across the frame on a pure black background, a photograph of a chain of internal lens reflections. The orbs differ in size and opacity, some circular, some slightly hexagonal, and the chain is not perfectly straight, with one orb sitting a little off the line. They grow dimmer and more elongated toward one end, and their colour shifts from pale cyan to faint magenta along the chain. Subtle grain, only light on black.
ghosts.coated_ghost: A single soft circular ghost with a strong magenta to green coating tint on a pure black background, a macro photograph of an internal reflection from a multi-coated lens element. The disc is dim and translucent, magenta across most of its area and shifting to a green-cyan cast along one edge where the coating reflects at a different angle. Its edge is soft and slightly uneven, and a faint pale streak crosses it diagonally. Off axis, fine grain, empty black surround.
ghosts.elongated_ghost: A single dim ghost stretched into a soft elliptical shape on a pure black background, a macro photograph of an internal lens reflection far off axis. The ellipse points toward the corner of the frame, is brighter at its outer end, and shows blue fringing on one long edge and red on the other. Its interior has a faint darker band, and the shape is slightly asymmetrical, one end broader than the other. Off centre, subtle grain, empty black around it.
ghosts.heptagon_ghost: A single seven-sided aperture ghost of pale amber light on a pure black background, a macro photograph of an internal reflection shaped by a seven-blade iris. The heptagon has faintly curved edges and slightly uneven blade angles, one side visibly shorter than the others. The interior is dim and mottled, the rim a touch brighter, with a thin cyan fringe on the upper edges from the coating. A faint smudge softens one corner. Slightly off axis, fine grain, only the ghost on black.
ghosts.ghost_chain: A row of small aperture ghosts in a line across a pure black background, a photograph of successive internal reflections from a stacked lens, each one dimmer than the last. The nearest ghost is a soft hexagon of pale green light, the following ones shrink and fade, changing tint toward magenta and becoming more circular. The spacing is slightly irregular and one ghost is missing from the line. Off centre, subtle grain, empty black elsewhere.
ghosts.fringed_annulus: A single annular ghost, a soft ring of dim light with a hollow dark centre, on a pure black background, a macro photograph of an internal reflection from a lens element. The annulus has strong chromatic fringing, a red outer edge and a blue-cyan inner edge, with the fringe wider on one side. The ring is slightly thicker at the bottom, and a small notch of lost brightness sits near the top. Slightly off axis, fine grain, only the ring on black.
ghosts.amber_bubble: One small complete circle of translucent amber light floating alone in the middle of a wide empty black frame, a macro photograph of an internal reflection in an uncoated vintage lens. The whole circle is visible with generous empty black on every side of it, its thin golden rim is brighter along the lower left and fades almost away opposite, and the interior is dim and faintly mottled with one small hot yellow point just inside the edge. Small in frame, warm, soft, fine grain, only light on black.

rays.glint_rays: A compact bright core of pure light with long thin diffraction spikes fanning outward on a pure black background, a photograph of a point source through a camera lens with an iris of irregular blades. The spikes have a brighter narrow centre and soft edges, they are uneven in length and angle, a few reaching much further than the rest, with faint haze between them. Subtle red-to-blue colour separation along the longest spikes. Slightly off centre, fine grain, otherwise empty black.
rays.broken_rays: Interrupted clusters of light rays radiating from a small bright point on a pure black background, a photograph of a starburst partially blocked as if the source shines through gaps in foliage. The rays are broken into uneven segments, some faint and short, some sharp and long, with an asymmetric distribution weighted to one side. A soft haze fills the gaps and the source itself is out of frame. Dim, grainy, only light on black.
rays.shimmer: A small bright core with long soft irregular rays fanning out unevenly on a pure black background, a photograph of a point light starburst through real glass. A few dominant rays stretch far across the frame with many fainter ones between them, the spacing not quite regular, and the rays on one side are noticeably longer than on the other. A faint chromatic edge, warm inside and cool outside, runs along each ray. Slightly off centre, subtle grain, empty black elsewhere.
rays.silky_shimmer: Delicate silky rays of light radiating with uneven spacing and length from an off-centre bright point on a pure black background, a long-exposure photograph of a starburst through a slightly hazy lens. The rays are extremely fine and soft with a gentle veiling haze around them, gathered more densely on the upper half than the lower. One ray is broken into two segments by a faint smudge. Subtle grain, dim, only light on black.
rays.spike_ball: A dense ball of dozens of fine soft light needles radiating from a small bright core in every direction on a pure black background, a photograph of a starburst through a dusty lens. The needle lengths are uneven and organic, some rays noticeably brighter than others, and the whole burst leans slightly asymmetric with a thinner patch on one side. A faint blue fringe tips the longest needles. Off centre, subtle grain, empty black around it.
rays.soft_urchin: A soft round burst of many short fuzzy light spikes on a pure black background, a photograph of a dim point source scattered into a fuzzy starburst. The spikes have irregular lengths and clump gently in places, leaving small gaps, and the whole burst is dimmer on its lower side. A faint warm halo sits beneath the spikes and a few tiny dust specks glint nearby. Delicate, off centre, fine grain, otherwise empty black.
rays.sparkle_burst: An explosion of dozens of extremely fine hairline light rays from a tiny brilliant centre on a pure black background, a photograph of a sparkle through a camera lens. The ray lengths are very uneven, sparse and delicate like a frost crystal, with a slightly asymmetric distribution favouring one diagonal. One or two rays show faint prismatic colour along their length while the rest stay white. Dim, off centre, subtle grain, only light on black.
rays.dust_sparkle: Tiny sparkling points of light scattered unevenly around a faint central glow on a pure black background, a macro photograph of illuminated dust motes, each with a minute cross-shaped glint. The points vary in size and brightness, cluster more densely on one side, and a few are slightly out of focus into soft dots. The central glow is dim and slightly lopsided. Subtle grain, delicate, otherwise empty black.
rays.six_point_star: A clean six-pointed diffraction star from a bright point source on a pure black background, a photograph through a lens with a six-blade iris. Six long thin spikes with a brighter narrow core radiate at roughly sixty-degree intervals, but their lengths are uneven, two opposite spikes stretching much further, and one spike is visibly dimmer. Subtle red-to-blue colour separation runs along each spike near its tip. Slightly off centre, fine grain, only light on black.
rays.eight_point_star: An eight-pointed diffraction star from a bright point source on a pure black background, a photograph through a lens with an eight-blade iris. Eight thin spikes with bright cores and soft edges radiate at even angles, but one diagonal pair is longer and brighter and the vertical pair is faint and slightly bent. A tiny soft glow surrounds the core with a faint warm halo, and colour separation appears near the spike tips. Off centre, fine grain, empty black elsewhere.
rays.fourteen_point_star: A fourteen-pointed diffraction star on a pure black background, a photograph of a point source through a lens with a seven-blade iris producing paired spikes. Fourteen fine thin rays with brighter centres radiate outward, with uneven lengths and a slight angular wobble so the spacing is not perfectly regular. A few spikes carry a faint rainbow fringe near their ends, and the lower-left group is dimmer. Slightly off centre, fine grain, only the star on black.
rays.asymmetric_spikes: A lopsided diffraction starburst from a small brilliant point on a pure black background, a photograph through a lens with an irregular damaged iris. The spikes radiate in a clearly asymmetric pattern, several long ones bunched on the right and only short stubby ones on the left, with one spike split into a faint doubled line. A dim veiling glow around the core, faint colour separation along the longest spike. Off centre, subtle grain, empty black around.
rays.diffraction_cross: A single thin four-pointed diffraction cross from a point source on a pure black background, a photograph of light through a lens with a narrow rectangular two-blade iris. Two long extremely thin lines cross at a small bright core, one axis much longer and brighter than the other, and the lines show faint periodic beading along their length with a subtle red-to-blue fringe. A small warm glow sits at the intersection. Slightly off centre, fine grain, only light on black.

streaks.anamorphic_streak: A single horizontal anamorphic streak of light stretching across a pure black background, a photograph of a point source through a cylindrical lens element. The streak has a thin hairline bright core surrounded by a soft wide vertical halo, tinted blue-cyan from the lens coating with a warmer white centre. Its thickness varies slightly along its length, it is brighter on the left, and the tips fade into faint blue chromatic fringing. Wide frame, subtle grain, only light on black.
streaks.layered_streak: Several overlapping horizontal streaks of soft light on a pure black background, a photograph of reflections off a stack of cylindrical lens elements. The streaks vary in width and brightness, one thin hairline core with two fainter wider halos above and below it, slightly offset vertically. Tints vary between teal, pale blue and a faint warm amber, and one streak is shorter and cut off on the right. Wide frame, subtle grain, otherwise empty black.
streaks.smeared_light: A horizontal smear of cool light with ragged soft edges on a pure black background, a long-exposure photograph of a light source smeared through an anamorphic lens element. The smear has faint internal streaky texture, is brighter at one end and fades through cyan to near black at the other, with subtle red and blue colour separation along its top and bottom edges. A faint thin secondary streak runs parallel below it. Wide frame, fine grain, only light on black.
streaks.thin_stripe: One very thin long horizontal stripe of soft light crossing a pure black background, a photograph of a distant point source through a cylindrical lens element. The hairline core is delicate blue-white with a faint soft glow around it, brightness varying subtly along its length with a slightly brighter knot near the centre. The stripe bends by a hair over its length and its right tip frays into faint cyan fringing. Wide frame, subtle grain, empty black elsewhere.
streaks.cyan_hairline: A razor-thin horizontal hairline of intense cyan light with a soft wide pale halo on a pure black background, a photograph of a bright point source through an anamorphic cylindrical element with a strong blue coating. The core is almost pure white at its centre and turns saturated cyan toward the ends, its halo thicker on the upper side. Faint periodic beading breaks the line at a few points. Wide frame, fine grain, only light on black.
streaks.double_streak: Two horizontal anamorphic streaks of light, one bright and one faint, on a pure black background, a photograph of a point source through cylindrical lens elements producing a primary and a secondary reflection. The primary streak has a sharp blue-white core and soft halo, the secondary sits a little above it, dimmer, slightly shorter and tinted magenta from the coating. Both vary in thickness along their length, the primary brighter on the right. Wide frame, subtle grain, empty black elsewhere.
streaks.warm_streak: A single horizontal streak of warm amber light on a pure black background, a photograph of a tungsten point source through an anamorphic cylindrical lens element. The streak has a bright thin core with a soft wide halo, its colour shifting from warm orange at the centre to faint blue-cyan at the outer tips where the coating dominates. The halo is uneven, slightly thicker on the underside, with a faint dust speck glinting along it. Wide frame, fine grain, only light on black.
streaks.tapered_streak: A horizontal streak of light that tapers from a bright soft blob at one end to a fine hairline at the other on a pure black background, a photograph of an off-axis source through an anamorphic cylindrical element. The bright end is blue-white and slightly blown out with a soft halo, the thin end fades into cyan fringing. The taper is not perfectly straight, bending slightly downward, with faint ragged texture along the halo. Wide frame, subtle grain, empty black elsewhere.

rings.thin_ring: A single thin circle of soft light with a delicate thin-film rainbow fringe on a pure black background, a macro photograph of an interference ring inside a lens. The ring has a hollow black interior, slightly uneven thickness and brightness around its circumference, with a faint gap where it almost disappears at the top left. Colours shift from a warm orange outer edge to a cool violet inner edge. Slightly off centre, subtle grain, only the ring on black.
rings.double_ring: Two thin concentric circles of dim light on a pure black background, a macro photograph of interference rings from a thin-film coating inside a lens. The outer ring is slightly warmer and patchier than the inner one, and both are uneven in brightness, brighter on the right side. The two rings are very slightly off centre from each other, and the inner ring is a touch broken near the bottom. Hollow interior, subtle grain, empty black elsewhere.
rings.spectral_ring: One thin circular ring of light split into a continuous rainbow spectrum around its circumference on a pure black background, a macro photograph of thin-film interference in a lens coating. Red bleeds outward and blue inward with the spectrum blending smoothly, but the ring is noticeably brighter and wider on one side and thins to a faint line opposite. A faint second dimmer ring hugs it just inside. Hollow black centre, off axis, fine grain, only light on black.
rings.interference_rings: A set of many fine closely spaced concentric rings of faint light, like interference fringes between two glass surfaces, on a pure black background, a macro photograph of thin-film interference. The rings shift colour outward through pale yellow, magenta, green and blue, and they are not perfectly circular, slightly squashed on one side with a faint wobble in their spacing. Brightness falls off toward the edge and one arc is broken by a small dust speck. Off centre, subtle grain, empty black elsewhere.
rings.broken_arc: A single thin ring of pale light that is only partially visible, an incomplete arc on a pure black background, a macro photograph of an interference ring inside a lens partly occluded by the iris. About two thirds of the circle is present, fading out at both ends, with a delicate rainbow fringe along the arc, red outside and blue inside. The arc thickness is uneven, thicker at the bottom, and its brightness is patchy. Off centre, fine grain, only the arc on black.
rings.ring_cluster: Several thin rings of dim light of different sizes, overlapping and not concentric, scattered on a pure black background, a macro photograph of multiple interference rings from stacked lens elements. Each ring carries a faint thin-film colour tint, one green, one magenta, one pale gold, and their brightness varies around the circumference. One of the rings is broken, and the largest is barely visible. Hollow interiors, off centre, subtle grain, empty black elsewhere.
rings.offset_ring: A thin ring of soft light with a faint fuzzy secondary ring slightly displaced from it on a pure black background, a macro photograph of an interference ring reflected twice inside a lens. The primary ring is crisp with a faint rainbow fringe, the secondary copy is dimmer, blurrier and shifted a little to the right, so they overlap on one side. Both are uneven in brightness and the primary ring has a small dim notch. Hollow black centre, off axis, fine grain, only the rings on black.
rings.brushed_crescent: A broad crescent of pale gold light fringed with rainbow along its outer edge on a pure black background, a macro photograph of a barrel-clipped reflection in a large anamorphic lens. Fine radial hairs run through the body of the crescent like brushed metal, blue fringing sits outside and warm gold inside, and one horn tapers further than the other. Curved, dim at the tips, off centre, fine grain, only light on black.

hoops.chroma_hoop: A large broad partial hoop of light with a smooth rainbow spectrum across its band on a pure black background, a photograph of a wide annular ghost reflection inside a lens. Red on the outside blends through green to blue on the inside, the band has soft inner and outer edges, and it is brighter on one side and fades unevenly, thinning to almost nothing at one end. A faint wobble in the curvature of the arc, subtle grain, only light on black.
hoops.ghost_hoop: A very large faint arc of soft pale light, an incomplete broad hoop fading at both ends, on a pure black background, a photograph of a large dim annular ghost from an internal lens reflection. The band is wide with soft edges, its colour drifts from warm on one side to cool on the other, and its brightness is patchy along its length with one dim gap. A hint of dust texture sits in the band. Off centre, subtle grain, empty black elsewhere.
hoops.wide_annulus: A broad soft annular ghost, a wide ring of dim light with a dark hollow centre, on a pure black background, a photograph of a large internal lens reflection. The band has smooth soft inner and outer edges and a pale green-cyan coating tint that shifts to faint magenta on one side. Brightness varies around the ring, strongest at the lower right and dropping off unevenly, with a slight change in thickness. Slightly off axis, fine grain, only the annulus on black.
hoops.wobbly_hoop: A large soft hoop of dim light whose ring is visibly not a perfect circle, on a pure black background, a photograph of an annular ghost from a slightly decentred lens element. The band bulges outward on one side and pinches inward opposite, with soft edges and a faint amber tint that shifts to pale blue along the pinched side. Brightness is uneven with one bright patch and a faint dark gap. Hollow interior, off centre, subtle grain, empty black elsewhere.
hoops.split_hoop: A broad partial hoop of soft light divided into two arcs by a dark gap on a pure black background, a photograph of an annular ghost reflection partly cut by the edge of the iris. The two arcs have soft inner and outer edges, a subtle red outer fringe and blue inner fringe, and the longer arc is brighter and wider than the shorter one. The curvature is slightly irregular. Off centre, fine grain, only light on black.
hoops.coated_hoop: A large soft annular ghost with a strong coating colour shift on a pure black background, a photograph of a broad hollow ring reflection inside a multi-coated lens. The band is deep magenta over most of its length, turning to green-cyan across one section where the reflection angle changes, with soft wide edges. Brightness is asymmetric, one side almost fading into black, and a faint smaller ghost sits just inside the ring. Off axis, subtle grain, empty black elsewhere.

caustics.caustic_fold: A folded cusp of concentrated light inside a soft dim disc on a pure black background, a macro photograph of a light caustic focused through an imperfect glass lens element. The four-pointed cusp has organic curved edges and bright creases where light concentrates, slightly askew so one point is longer and brighter than the others. Faint rainbow fringing appears along the sharpest crease and the disc around it is unevenly lit. Off centre, subtle grain, only light on black.
caustics.water_caustic: An organic net of curved intersecting filaments of soft light inside a faint disc on a pure black background, a macro photograph of light refracted through rippled water on glass. The filaments form irregular cells of different sizes, brighter where they cross, with the mesh denser on one side and fading out on the other. A faint cyan fringe traces the brightest filament and a small dark patch interrupts the net. Dim, off axis, fine grain, empty black elsewhere.
caustics.shard_burst: Pure light split into a fan of soft overlapping wedge-shaped beams radiating asymmetrically from one bright point on a pure black background, a photograph of a point source refracted through cracked glass. Each wedge carries a slightly different cool tint of cyan, pale blue or violet, edges soft and organic, with the beams on the right longer and brighter than those on the left. A faint haze fills the gaps and one wedge is faintly doubled. Off centre, subtle grain, only light on black.
caustics.ripple_caustic: Concentric ripple caustics of soft light, wavy bright bands radiating from a point, on a pure black background, a macro photograph of light passing through a lens with a wet, gently rippled surface. The bands are uneven in spacing and thickness, brighter on one side and slightly distorted near the top, with a faint thin-film colour shimmer along the brightest band. Dim, organic, off centre, subtle grain, empty black elsewhere.
caustics.wet_glass_net: A soft network of bright light filaments and dark cells across a dim glowing patch on a pure black background, a macro photograph of light refracted through a film of water droplets on a lens surface. The cells vary widely in size, filaments are brighter where they meet, and the pattern is stretched diagonally toward one corner. A faint red-blue fringe appears on the brightest strands and a single larger droplet forms a dark hole with a bright rim. Off axis, fine grain, only light on black.
caustics.cusp_disc: A dim soft disc of light containing a single sharp curved cusp, a crescent-shaped crease of concentrated brightness, on a pure black background, a macro photograph of a caustic through a slightly warped lens element. The cusp sits off the centre of the disc, its curve brighter at one tip, with a faint prismatic fringe along the crease and a fainter secondary cusp echoing it. The disc edge is soft and uneven. Off centre, subtle grain, empty black elsewhere.
caustics.filament_web: A sparse web of thin curved filaments of light on a pure black background, a macro photograph of caustics from a bright source refracting through textured glass. The filaments loop and intersect loosely, thicker and brighter near one focus point and thinning to faint threads further away, with irregular gaps. A subtle green to magenta colour shift runs along the longer strands and a faint dust glint sits on one node. Dim, off axis, fine grain, only light on black.
caustics.prismatic_fan: A fan of narrow coloured rays spreading out of one corner into a striped patch of spectrum on a pure black background, a macro photograph of light diffracted through a scratched lens coating. The stripes run red through gold into deep blue and stay parallel across the patch while the rays fan unevenly, two of them longer and brighter than the rest. One stripe breaks where the coating is worn thin. Sharp, fine, off centre, subtle grain, only light on black.
caustics.prismatic_patch: A soft irregular smear of faint rainbow banding floating in a wide empty black frame, a macro photograph of thin-film interference across a fingerprint on the front element. The bands are pale and unevenly spaced, curving with the smear and fading out at both ends rather than stopping, with one washed-out gap where the film thickens. Small in frame, low contrast, soft edged, fine grain, only light on black.

lens_dirt.dust_scratches: Full-frame wide 16:9 macro photograph of the front surface of a dirty camera lens lit from behind against a near-black background: hundreds of tiny dust particles of varied sizes, a few faint smudges and three or four hairline scratches catching the light. The particles are scattered unevenly with denser clumps in one corner and a nearly clean area elsewhere, a few larger specks slightly out of focus into soft dots. All very dim and delicate, fine grain, the glass itself invisible.
lens_dirt.greasy_smudge: Full-frame wide 16:9 macro photograph of faint greasy fingerprint smudges and streaked wipe marks on a glass surface catching low glancing light against a near-black background. The smears are barely visible pale grey haze with soft organic edges, one broad thumb smear on the left and a few thinner streaks trailing to the right, with a faint oily rainbow sheen on the thickest patch. Uneven, sparse, subtle grain, the glass itself invisible.
lens_dirt.particle_field: Full-frame wide 16:9 macro photograph of sparse floating dust motes catching light in darkness against a near-black background. Each mote is a soft dim speck, most tiny and sharp, a few larger ones defocused into soft pale discs, spread in an uneven natural distribution with a loose drift toward one side and an almost empty zone in the centre. One or two motes show a faint coloured glint. Delicate, dim, fine grain.
lens_dirt.droplet_mist: Full-frame wide 16:9 macro photograph of fine condensation mist and a few small water droplets on a glass surface catching faint light against a near-black background. Each droplet is a tiny dim glint with a darker centre and bright rim, the mist thicker in one corner and thinning to drier patches, with a few larger droplets that have merged into irregular shapes. One droplet has run, leaving a short trail. Sparse, subtle grain, the glass itself invisible.
lens_dirt.wipe_marks: Full-frame wide 16:9 macro photograph of circular cloth wipe marks and micro-scratch swirls on a lens surface catching glancing light against a near-black background.
